[/font][font=Courier New][CP]Kitties Meowmere

This is a visual reskin of the meowmere in a few different
colours and kitties, the mod includes presets that you can choose of the bat.
By default the meowmere will be reskin with 'Candy' but you can
choose to change this in the config. I also included an option to mix and match
the blade colours and different cat faces so you can mix around
for different combos of your liking. 

Preset must be set to NONE to be able to customise the meowmere.[/font][/center][center]﻿[/center]
